behavior: Project scaffolding: FastAPI + Next.js skeleton, auth/JWT, RBAC core, audit trail infra, shared maker-checker workflow state machine, CI check pipeline
User Group Management: CRUD on user groups, search/filter, group-wise privilege setup
User Management: CRUD, maker-checker profile approval, lock/unlock, activate/deactivate, session policy
Login: user ID/password auth, lockout after 5 failed attempts, self-service password reset
Parameter Management: admin CRUD for ~36 reference/lookup lists used system-wide
Holiday Setup: court-wise (Lower Court / High Court) holiday calendar management
Lawyer Package Bill Setup: add/edit/delete/verify billing packages, extend package amount
Dashboard: real-time stats for notices, approvals, auctions, case updates, bills, court schedules
1st Legal Notice / Reminder Notice: create/send/verify notices, CBS customer search, served-notice history
Case Merit Analysis (CMA): pre-litigation viability workflow, document archiving, pre-litigation TAT workflow, land/property vetting workflow
Auction Management: record creation/validation, publication management, system-generated publication copies, bidder info, final auction memo
Account Statement Generation: CBS-integrated statement generation with interest application
Jari Statement with Certificate: Aurtho Jari statement/certificate generation from CBS data
Lower Court Suit Management: suit file CRUD, reassignment, Arji copy upload, expense recording, hearing/limitation tracking
Case Steps Update: daily progress tracking, lawyer expense entry, automated milestone notifications
Arising Case from Original Case: linked execution suits, session cases, merged suit monitoring, case history tree
Bill Processing and Disbursement: lawyer/court/publication/entertainment/conveyance bills, Finance Division integration, recovery/settlement workflow
Court Fee Return and Adjustment: return unutilized fees, adjust against next case, audit log
HC & AD Matters: High Court/Appellate Division case filing, arising case tracking, lawyer expense management, cross-court case history
Case Against Bank: record/track cases filed against the bank, lawyer bill integration, centralized repository
Employee Related & Other Legal Affairs Suit: non-account-linked internal/misc legal cases
Authorization Management: plaintiff change, case withdrawal, bail money withdrawal, court change, configurable other-request type
Warrant of Arrest Management: WOA recording, arrest history, execution bill entry, issuance/escalation tracking
Appeal Bail Money Deposit & Withdraw: deposit/withdrawal entry, balance tracking, mobile access with MFA and offline sync
Document Upload: multi-format upload with metadata, search/retrieval, audit trail
Reports: ~48 reports including Bangladesh Bank regulatory formats, portfolio/segment/officer/lawyer summaries
Notification: execution-case reminders, fixed-date notifications, next-date-not-updated alerts, communication log
Customer 360 Search: multi-parameter search, consolidated customer view across cases/financials/documents
Legal Memos and Notices Publication: admin memo/notice publishing with expiry management
System Settings: credential/password/session/CAPTCHA/API config, audit log, user login/activity history
Legal Opinion Management: submit/track opinion requests, record/retrieve opinions, response timelines
Task Management System: work request/task assignment, deadline tracking, completion status, outcome audit
